I recently visited Garde Manger Café in Vile Parle East, and while the food was enjoyable, the overall experience was far from satisfying.

Parking:
As with many cafés in this area, there is no dedicated parking available. Visitors traveling by car or bike should be prepared to look around for legal street parking — not very convenient.

Seating & Ambience:
The café offers both indoor and outdoor seating, but the space feels very tight and congested. The tables are extremely small — if you’re planning to order multiple dishes, you’ll struggle to fit everything on the table at once. It gets uncomfortable quickly.

Also, the tables are placed too close to each other, and when the café is full, the noise levels can be overwhelming. During our visit, there was a loud group nearby, and due to the cramped layout, it was hard to have a peaceful conversation or enjoy our food.

Service:
The service was slow and poorly coordinated. We ordered hummus with pita bread, and although we had already finished most of our meal, the pita bread hadn’t arrived. When we followed up, it was clear from the staff’s expressions that they had forgotten to place the order. It eventually arrived after a wait of 30+ minutes, which really disrupted the flow of our meal.

Food:
On the positive side, the food was genuinely good — tasty and fresh. The flavors were spot on, and if I had to rate just the food, I’d give it a thumbs-up.

⸻

Final Thoughts:
While the food is worth trying, the lack of space, poor service, and noisy environment took away from what could have been a nice café experience. I hope the management considers expanding the space and training the staff better to handle orders and communication.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited this place with my ex-colleagues, and to be honest, The vibe of the place is great for spending time with family.

We ordered quite a few dishes including prawns masala fry, bombil masala, bombil rawa fry, grilled pomfret, crab lollipop, chicken, and finally prawns biryani.

Talking about the food, the crab lollipop was interesting. It obviously felt like frozen food, but the taste was still good. However, most of the seafood dishes were a little disappointing for us. The fish dishes were not spicy enough and lacked that strong flavor we were expecting. The stuffed pomfret was just okay-okay and felt more like boiled fish rather than properly fried.

We also ordered a chicken dish and specifically requested it to be spicy, but unfortunately, it turned out a bit sweet, and none of us really liked it.

But the highlight of the meal was definitely the prawns biryani. It was really, really good and honestly the best dish we had there.

Overall, the ambience and company made the experience enjoyable, but food-wise, only a few dishes really stood out for us.

featured_reviews.name: hemali kantharia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our go-to family dinner spot for any and every occasion. From small celebrations to casual dinners, this place has always been our first choice. Over time we’ve tried almost everything on the menu, and every visit somehow turns into another food memory with family.

If there are two dishes I would recommend to anyone visiting, it has to be the Bombil Fry and Peri Peri Bombil. They are easily my brother’s and my absolute favourites perfectly crispy, full of flavour, and something we end up ordering almost every single time.

And no meal here feels complete without the Kokum Sarbat or Kokum Soda. That refreshing, tangy punch of flavour just balances the seafood so well and makes the whole experience even better.

Good food, great flavours, and the comfort of family dinners this place truly feels special to us. Easily one of the best seafood restaurants and definitely a spot we’ll keep coming back to.

featured_reviews.name: Mitesh Parmar
featured_reviews.review_text:
This was the final restaurant I attended on my trip and a great place to end on.

Unfortunately at the time of our attendance the A/C was not in working order which the manager/owner advised on prior to entering, however we still went in as they had fans going on.

Didn't plan to eat a lot but to take in the delights on offer as again this was a place recommended.

We were given good information by the manager on some of the dishes and on ordering the food arrived after a short time. temperatures were on point and flavours were amazing. The prawn starters were so good, especially the Prawns Garlic Butter, so much so we ordered another tray. I also order the Mutton Chops Ghee Roast and as it sat in front of me my mouth was watering. Spice level on this was perfect, had a nice little kick but was really enjoyable and not in a overpowering way. I found that the chop may have been slightly overdone to my liking, however this didn't take the enjoyment away from it.

The meals ordered were enjoyed by everyone in the party which also included children (they really enjoyed the Prawns Garlic Butter). Pricing of the meals and overall was very reasonable and this place is worth a visit if you have never been. I will look to return here again if I visit Mumbai again.

Celebrating the spirit of Onam in the grandeur of Sahara Star was truly a delightful experience. The plush property, located right next to Mumbai’s domestic airport, set the perfect stage for a festive indulgence. The lavish Sunday Brunch at The Earth Plate – Global Cuisine transformed into a traditional Kerala Sadhya spread, offering an authentic taste of heritage served with warmth and elegance.

The banana leaf thali came alive with a vibrant array of curries, pachadis, thorans, avial, olan, sambar, rasam, pulisery, and fluffy red rice – each dish bursting with homely flavors, perfectly balanced spices, and that comforting touch of Kerala’s culinary roots. Crisp papadams, tangy pickles, and steaming hot appams completed the meal, while payasam and other Indian sweets brought the feast to a heavenly close.

The buffet around the restaurant was equally indulgent, showcasing a harmony of regional Indian delicacies, global favorites, and stunning desserts – all beautifully curated in a festive floral setting that reflected the joy of Onam. The live counters, attentive chefs, and vibrant ambiance added to the overall charm, making it an immersive dining experience.

✨ From the soulful flavors on the leaf to the elegant hospitality and plush surroundings, the Onam Sadhya at Sahara Star was more than just a meal – it was a cultural celebration plated with luxury. We loved the food — the white sauce pasta was creamy and delicious, the dry Manchurian was flavourful, and the mint paneer was equally delicious. We also tried their special Belgium Brownie milkshake, which was super chocolaty and absolutely indulgent.
The staff is very courteous and polite, adding to the overall warm and pleasant experience.
The only downside was the seating policy — despite calling in advance, we were informed that weekend bookings are not accepted and only walk-ins are allowed. Additionally, they made us wait until all our friends had arrived before seating us, which felt a bit unnecessary.
Overall, it’s a wonderful family restaurant with good food, great ambience, and a well-designed rooftop setting. Definitely worth visiting for the food and ambience.

Visited this place with my friends after hearing a lot about it, and it truly lived up to the expectations. We had a fantastic experience—both the food and the overall vibe were excellent.

We ordered Bombil fry as a starter, along with Prawns Thali and Surmai Thali. Every single dish was 10/10. Personally, whenever I try a new place for fish, I judge it by the taste of the Bombil fry—and this one was outstanding. It was extremely fresh, perfectly crispy, and the masala was well balanced and nicely blended.

The same quality and freshness reflected in the Surmai and Prawns thali—authentic taste and very satisfying portions.

On the owner’s suggestion, we also tried their Mutton Thali for a change, and it was surprisingly excellent. The mutton was fresh, tender, and full of flavour, which is rare to find these days.

If you’re a seafood lover, this place is a must-visit. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy quality fish with great taste and vibes.
